method: Independently cross-checked literal third-person subject restrictions only. These filters never add a lexical meaning. Construction/valency withholds and unresolved cases are deferred to a separate reviewed patch, preserving existing supported clause translations. No personification or invented arguments; human operators and patients remain distinct.

entries.reason: Literal fluir/flow is supported for a flowing entity; unrestricted human metaphor needs exact source evidence before preserving that subject profile.
Resonar is literal reverberating sound; ordinary I echoed could mean repeating another speaker, which is not established for this exact Spanish pair.
Literal fluctuation supports a varying entity/quantity. The pair does not evidence a complete personal human opinion/state construction; restrict to it.
Literal sonar/sound describes an emitting instrument/entity; an unrestricted human action or appearance reading needs precise transitive/performer source evidence.
Literal afluir flowing supports liquid/entity it. The definition-free pair does not attest personal human influx or a figurative flow reading.
Literal oozing safely supports a liquid-emitting body/material entity. Human abstract-quality figuratives are not source-proved by this pair; restrict to it.
Literal rebrotar/burgeon supports fresh plant growth or recurrence of an entity/outbreak; a whole-person human figurative mapping needs exact source evidence.
Literal waning supports a diminishing entity. No complete source-attested human health/energy construction is present in this definition-free pair; restrict to it.
Balar/bleat is supported as an animal call; preserve literal singular it, not unrestricted human subjects without exact figurative source evidence.
Desovar/spawn is an egg-laying animal as subject; do not import human/computing spawn figuratives without source evidence.
Literal flowering has a plant subject. No independently sourced human flourishing figurative is present in this definition-free pair; restrict to entity it.

Literal surgir/arise is supported for an emerging issue/event/entity; unrestricted I arise can instead mean getting up, not established by this pair. Request explicit human emergence evidence before restoring ordinary.
Pest/parasite infestation safely supports an entity/animal it. Human crowd figuratives or deliberate human-caused infestation need exact source evidence; not inferred from a bilingual link.
Selected spark safely supports a spark-emitting entity. Human wit or deliberate striking is not proved by this definition-free chispear pair; restrict to it.
Literal connotation is carried by a word/sign/entity. No human-speaker use of the exact connote mapping is evidenced by this pair; restrict to it.
Literal abundar/abound supports an abundant substance/entity, not singular human I abound; human agreement/expansion uses would need separately sourced constructions.
Literal barking supports a dog/animal subject. No source-attested human speech figurative or imitation is supplied; restrict to animal it.

Literal germination supports a seed/plant subject. A human deliberately germinating seeds is a possible separate causative use but needs explicit Spanish valency evidence; restrict this unsensed pair to it.
